name: Flash ALOHA: robot learns dynamic, precise tasks at near human speed from 50 demonstrations, said to be fully open source
title: Flash ALOHA: robot learns dynamic, precise tasks at near human speed from 50 demonstrations, said to be fully open source
summary: A Stanford team (with Chelsea Finn) reports Flash ALOHA, which learns fast manipulation tasks from only 50 demonstrations via kinesthetic teaching, and says all code is open sourced. The post carries a video and no repo link was visible.
